app.description:
Record supported meetings automatically on your Mac, with rich transcripts processed on device. Transcripts captures microphone and system audio, identifies speakers, and creates summaries and action items. Save your recordings and Markdown notes in a folder you choose. The Mac App Store edition asks before recording by default; automatic recording is an option.

iPhone and iPad are companion recorders for conversations and voice notes. Choose iCloud Drive to share recordings with the Mac. Mobile apps do not automatically record phone calls on the same iPhone.

The app is free and open source. Audio processing happens on your device; optional iCloud file sync is separate. The website has its own analytics policy.

test.MAC_OS:
Please test a short supported meeting before relying on automatic recording.

1. Open Transcripts from the menu bar and choose a recordings folder.
2. Grant microphone and system-audio permissions. Test ask-first and automatic recording with your usual call app.
3. Confirm both your voice and the other participant appear in the transcript and audio playback.
4. Review speaker names, summaries, action items and saved Markdown notes. Processing time depends on your Mac and selected model.
5. If you use iPhone or iPad, check recordings in a shared iCloud Drive folder.

Report your macOS version, call app and reproduction steps through TestFlight. Please omit private meeting contents.
Setup guide: https://transcripts.doughatcher.com/guide/automatic-meeting-transcription/
test.IOS:
Please test recording, playback and sharing with the Mac companion.

1. Record a short conversation or voice note and check that audio and transcript are saved.
2. Open an existing recording, review its transcript and play back the audio.
3. On iPad, test the library and recording views in landscape and portrait.
4. Choose a shared iCloud Drive folder on iPhone/iPad and Mac, and check that recordings become available on both. Sync depends on iCloud and connectivity.

Automatic meeting detection and system-audio recording are Mac features. The iOS app does not automatically record phone calls on the same iPhone.

Report your device, iOS/iPadOS version and reproduction steps through TestFlight. Please omit private recording contents.
Mac companion and guide: https://transcripts.doughatcher.com/
